findings.question: Flags1/1 : placement simple ou assemblage silencieux ?
findings.answer: A4 calls native give with assembly assistance enabled and completion/update flag enabled. It equips first. If the new equipped component completes a recipe using equipped items, AI owners auto-assemble silently. A controlled human may receive an assembly prompt if the recipe discovery bit was not previously set; only affirmative message result0x7805 invokes assembly. Humans with that bit already set are not silently auto-combined by this path. Therefore blanket silent auto-combine is incorrect.

findings.question: Que fait le helper assemblage ?
findings.answer: It removes matching recipe components from equipped slots in descending slot order18..0 and equips the resulting combination artifact via normal equip helper. Backpack components are not considered by completion test or assembly helper. This is real inventory mutation, not only a notification or compatibility query.

findings.question: Ordre équipement et sac plein ?
findings.answer: First compatible empty equipped slot0..18, then backpack fallback. Full backpack does not prevent equipping. If no compatible equipped slot and64bag entries, placement fails and A4 caller ignores the return. Selection pool remains consumed; no source retry/refund. No existing equipment replaced to make room.

findings.question: Provenance ArtType/IsDisabled ?
findings.answer: Native44ca20 reads ARTRAITS.TXT through resource loader. It derives ArtType from column21 first-character code R/J/N/T/other, initializes IsDisabled=false for all144rows, then binary list marks exactly141,142,143 disabled. Recipe metadata is added later without changing ArtType or IsDisabled. These fields remain mutable afterwards.

findings.question: Exclure tous les combinés par legalArtifact ?
findings.status: not justified as universal selector predicate
findings.answer: The selector itself has no combined-artifact test. Initial loader does not disable every combined artifact: only141..143 are fixed-disabled. Some map-version/default-ban paths restrict recipe results, especially legacy version0x15 and older format gates. A universal combined-artifact exclusion cannot replace actual IsDisabled, ArtType and persistent map-ban state, which can be changed by scripts/mods. For modern144bit restriction input, the full supplied restriction state matters.
